translator_notes: Origin unclear, sounds like a modern song. 'Лична Калина ... ѝ напишала' is my reading: someone (Kalina) wrote a sad tale to the old mother; 'гороцвеќе' is a guess at 'wildflowers'. Lazaropole is a village in the Mala Reka region.
